blocks.content: Course: Build your First Web App with React
Here's what your src folder should look like now:
Later, as you add more components, you might want to create a components folder:

src/

├── components/

│   ├── EntryCard.jsx

│   ├── JournalForm.jsx

│   └── ...

├── App.jsx

└── index.jsx
For now, keeping everything in src is fine. Don't over-organize early.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
